About the role:

HR Business Partner will be reporting to the Head of Talent Management and Engagement, Human Resources. This position will be in Sydney, Australia. The selected candidate is expected to carry out the role of an HR business partner by enabling employee relations, promoting engagement, providing coaching, and advisory to managers on various HR policies and processes, and supporting global HR initiatives for the business unit. An ideal candidate would have between 8-10 years of similar experience in a mid to large size organization. 

Key Responsibilities:
•	Providing proactive HR advice and guidance to the leadership team and employees of the unit.
•	Advising and assisting managers in implementing HR processes and policies. 
•	Ensuring all managers and employees understand the company policies and procedures, applying them fairly and consistently.
•	Advising managers on all matters related to employee relations and ensuring compliance with employer obligations on an ongoing basis. 
•	Suggesting, developing, and owning all people-related initiatives/improvement processes to its roll-out and on-going compliance thereafter.
•	Undertaking additional duties as required on request to meet the needs of the business units.
•	Enabling continuous collaboration with other HR teams across the organization on an ongoing basis on all people related initiatives.

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Estimator
•	Salary Range: $75,000 - $95,000 per annum plus superannuation
•	Exciting opportunity to work in a professional setting.

About Us
PH Cleaning Enterprises Pty Ltd is a Queensland-based specialist in caulking and joint sealing services, delivering high-quality solutions across commercial and residential construction and maintenance projects. Our operations are built on strict adherence to safety standards, technical excellence, and exceptional client service. We work with builders, facility managers, and property owners throughout Queensland to ensure compliant, durable, and professional sealing outcomes.

About the role
The Estimator is responsible for calculating accurate and competitive cost estimates for commercial and residential cleaning contracts. This role requires conducting detailed site assessments, analysing client specifications, and preparing comprehensive proposals. The Estimator bridges the gap between sales and operations. They ensure all quotes are commercially viable, operationally deliverable, and aligned with company profitability targets.

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Prepare accurate cost estimates for prospective commercial and residential cleaning contracts.
•	Calculate labor requirements, material costs, equipment depreciation, and overheads.
•	Apply appropriate profit margins in line with company pricing strategies.
•	Draft and submit formal proposals, tender documents, and service agreements.
•	Review and interpret complex tender documents and scope-of-work specifications.
•	Conduct physical site inspections across various Queensland locations.
•	Measure floor plans and assess site-specific conditions.
•	Identify potential operational challenges, access issues, and safety hazards.
•	Determine the appropriate cleaning methodologies and equipment required for each site.
•	Conduct formal handovers of successful quotes to the operations team.
•	Provide detailed site assessment notes, labor budgets, and equipment lists to operational managers.
•	Collaborate with operations staff to review the financial performance of active contracts.
•	Adjust future estimating formulas based on operational feedback and actual time-and-motion data.
•	Maintain accurate records of all quotes, site assessments, and client communications.
•	Communicate with prospective and existing clients to clarify service requirements.

Essential Skills

•	Strong understanding of commercial cleaning methodologies, equipment capabilities, and production rates.
•	Advanced numerical skills with the ability to calculate complex labor and material costs accurately.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office (particularly Excel) and industry-standard estimating or CRM software.

Qualifications needed:

•	Minimum Diploma level or equivalent relevant work experience
•	Minimum one year of work experience on relevant position
•	White Card
•	Driver’s License

What We Offer

•	Competitive salary based on experience
•	Opportunities for professional growth and training
•	A supportive and dynamic work environment
•	Work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technology

Salary:  The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $75,000-$95,000 plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply: 11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.
